spec.decision: Closed UTC daily archive; next observed 15m opening execution
spec.daily_input: Aggregate observed Kraken trade-only intervals; do not add execution rows
spec.selection: Same January 1–7 formation universe; no subsequent winner selection
spec.trend_hold_28d: Original top-two 28d leader entry; retain until EMA21 direction breaks, not rank loss
spec.weekly_leader_28d: Original top-two entry/top-four retention on Monday UTC only; risk exits still apply every observed bar
spec.channel_28d: Break previous 28 daily highs/lows and EMA21; retain until EMA21 direction breaks
spec.stop: Unchanged: three daily ATRs, clipped at 6–20%; trailing starts after one initial stop-distance gain
spec.blend: One shared account, one position per asset, at most 50% per family at entry

universe.limitation: Selection uses formation data only; published-archive omissions can still introduce survivorship bias. Later missing members do not remove an asset.

limitations: Unvalidated research. Q1/Q2 have already influenced development; this is not untouched validation.
No forecast calibration gate is reused. New fixed entry/exit hypotheses are explicitly different strategies.
Long-only results are cash-funded spot approximations. Synthetic shorts are separate experiments, not executable spot shorts.
Synthetic short carry is a 0.03%/day assumption; actual borrow, margin availability, funding and liquidation are not modeled.
Alpaca rate sensitivity uses Kraken data and simplified cash-fee accounting, not Alpaca venue or asset eligibility evidence.
Kraken archive intervals without trades are omitted. Closed daily OHLCV aggregates observed trades; a wholly absent day resets indicators. No synthetic execution quotes are added.
Daily rankings use only previously closed data; hold-rank buffers reduce forced turnover, but stops and exits still incur costs.
No account or per-trade profit target. Stops, trend exits, 28-day time exits and drawdown triggers can still realize losses.
Higher equity increases stake and capacity through the shared engine; it does not manufacture additional signals.
Trigger/extrema fills remain intrabar approximations, with gap and missing-data risks. No broker orders or activation.
